header.running_head: Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) Supports the Opinion of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and the other Sahabah (RA) Echo the Same Opinion

blocks.text: well. Although Hadhrat Ali (RA) was also present, he remained silent all the while.
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Gives Glad Tidings to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), Who is Pleased by this and then Delivers a Lecture to Motivate the Sahabah (RA) to March in Jihaad

(Addressing Hadhrat Ali (RA)) Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "What is your opinion, O Abul Hasan?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "I feel that whether you march against them yourself or whether you send others against them, you will have Allaah's assistance, Inshaa Allaah." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "May Allaah always give you good news! How do you know this?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) replied, "I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say that this Deen will always dominate those who oppose it until the Deen and its adherents are victorious." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) exclaimed, "Subhaanallaah! What a beautiful Hadith! You have made me very happy with this. May Allaah always keep you happy." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then stood up to address the people. After duly praising Allaah and sending salutations to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "O people! Allaah has certainly blessed you with Islaam and honoured you with the institution of Jihaad. Through this Deen Allaah has elevated your status over the people of other religions. Therefore, O servants of Allaah, prepare to fight the Romans in Shaam. I shall appoint commanders over you and make flags for you. Obey your Rabb, do not disobey your commanders and make good your intentions and your provisions for food and drink for Allaah is with those who have Taqwa and who do things well."
An Exchange of Words between Hadhrat Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Amr bin Sa'eed (RA) and Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) Advises his Brother to Assist Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

(After listening to the address of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)) The Sahabah (RA) were silent without any of them offering any response. Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "O assembly of Muslims! What is the matter with you that you do not respond to the Khalifah of Rasulullaah ﷺ when he is calling you towards that which will give life to you?" Had the gains been near at hand and the journey an easy one, you would have certainly jumped to it[^1]." In response to this, Hadhrat Amr bin Sa'eed (RA) stood up and retorted, "O son of Khattaab! Are you comparing us to the example of the Munaafiqeen? What prevented you from taking the initiative to do that which you accused us of not doing?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) knows well that I will surely respond if he calls me and fight if he asks me to." Hadhrat Amr bin
Here Hadhrat Umar (RA) was referring to a statement in verse 42 of Surah Taubah.
